description: This is a client-sided minecraft mod for Fabric 1.21.11 designed to offer 3D model compatibility in resource packs with item models!

mods.name: 3D Item Icons
mods.description: Renders item icons in text as live inventory-style item renders, so 3D resource pack models look in chat, server GUIs, tab lists, scoreboards and text displays exactly like they look in your inventory.

releases.notes:
This is the initial release for the 3D Item Icons mod! This mod allows you to see 3D modeled item models just as they appear in your inventory instead of appearing "unfolded" or "flat". 

This mod is compatible with Fabric 1.21.11 of Java minecraft.
